note: r10: r09 + when to ask. A new part asks for confirmation (dup / delete with links / recurring without occurrence), for a missing value, an undecidable kind, a plural count that disagrees, or a message that asks for nothing; the hint clarity missing_one / none always asks, clear lifts an ask that only came from this code's own reference reading. r07: r06 + in-session memory of changes in flight and of what the user stated. Tasks (write request / write question / card → done | cancelled) with cancel / amend / resume / copy relations; facts per subject (who: contact or me) and their place / day; user-defined names (我说X就是Y); company-contact facts keyed by stored company; standing topics and "this conversation" scope; R25 kind-only follow-ups carry person / time / place. Every new deciding rule binds only on unique evidence.

structure.text.ts: fold(): NFKC, lower case, Latin accents stripped, traditional / shinjitai → simplified table, katakana → hiragana; substring and word-boundary helpers; fre(): folds a regex literal (traditional / shinjitai / katakana) so it runs on folded text; r05: fold() keeps a katakana mask per folded string (katakanaMask), so name spotting can tell katakana words from hiragana after folding
structure.time.ts: calendar parser on folded text: today/tomorrow, this/next/week-after-next, weekdays with or without week, weekends / workdays, explicit dates and ranges, bare day of month, months and month parts, relative (next day / next week of the window before), anaphora (那天 / その間); 一下 is never the 下 of 下周; 周日程 / 周日期 are not Sunday; next / this weekend; 第二天 / 翌日; 出張中 / その期間 / during the trip as range anaphora; r05: clock times with am / pm after hh:mm, CJK numeral hours (七点半), 午後 / 夜 / 晚上 prefixes; a month-day range inside one month (Dec 7 to 13 / Dec 7-13)
structure.lexicon.ts: general vocabulary only: pronouns, pointers and classifiers, ordinals, kind words, verbs, status words, follow-up markers (correct / repeat / only / adjust / this-time / session-scope / defer / unsure), honorifics, role synonyms, generic company suffixes, major cities; r03: more generic company suffixes (industries, holdings, group …); r04: EN_COMMON — frequent English function, time, request and everyday words (general vocabulary, none of this world's names); r05: PLACE_TABLE — a general gazetteer of major Japanese cities, prefectures and Tokyo / Osaka districts, Chinese and Asian cities: Latin spellings → CJK spellings (first reported), kana spellings read through romaji; romanised titles (bucho / kacho / shacho / bengoshi) as role words; more defer markers (後回し / hold off / on hold …)
structure.world.ts: runtime index of the world: records by id with searchable text; per-account name forms (full, given, family, reading, alias, alias table, company cores); person spotting with single-character surnames only in name position and role narrowing; name groups (company + surname intersect); place words from the account's locations; romaji forms of kana readings (family, given, both orders); pinyin forms of Chinese names (full both orders, run-together, two-syllable given name, surname of 4+ letters that is not an English word) and of company cores (5+ letters); r04: a kana-only name form (reading, kana given name) is a name only before an honorific or as its own kana word (no kana before it; after it no kana or one particle), two-kana forms need the honorific; a name form strictly inside a longer time expression (the expression widened by an adjacent next / last / this / coming / following) is not a name; a Latin form that is an everyday English word (lexicon EN_COMMON) is a name only in name position (title or with / to / from / ask … before it, possessive, CJK pointer or honorific after it, CJK on both sides, or the whole reply); a company core that is a time expression alone is not a separate form; a lone surname character after kana or before a Japanese case particle (not at the start) is a word unless a title follows; the Japanese question word 何 / 誰 before kana is never a surname; a Japanese contact's kanji given name alone needs an honorific / pointer / particle after it, a contact verb before it, or to be the whole reply; r05: Latin-letter names have the family name last (first when a hyphenated given name follows); a Latin reading of a CJK name gives family / given / full forms (hyphenated, joined, spaced); pinyin forms also for Chinese contacts with a Latin reading; a pinyin surname of any length is a family form — one that is an everyday English word or a romanised word (he / long / song …) only with a title before or an honorific / role after (titledLatin), one shorter than 4 letters only in name position; Japanese contacts with a one-character kanji surname also get its pinyin (R16); the family reading in kana is a family form (name position includes a role word after it); a lone CJK surname followed by any role word is a name (X弁護士 / X部長); romanised titles after a Latin name (-san / -bucho, also as role words); a Chinese name stored as an alias of a Latin-named contact whose surname character romanises to the Latin surname gives family / given forms; a second pass spots katakana words (script from the fold mask) and hiragana words before an honorific, and runs of 2–4 Chinese transliteration characters after a contact verb / before a pointer, by sound against the Latin words of names and aliases; a 2–3 kanji run before an honorific (or the whole reply) that reads as a contact's kana given name; a romanised hit also lists Chinese contacts whose names have characters the pinyin table lacks when the known characters agree (partialLatin); titleSex marks Mr. / Ms. / 先生 (Chinese only) / 女士 next to a hit; a 2-character Chinese name after a degree adverb (很 / 太 / 非常 …) is the ordinary word; company cores lose a leading place word (gazetteer) and are never a bare place word or a generic suffix word; r06: a Latin form adjacent to a hyphen and more letters is part of a hyphenated word (not a name) unless a romanised title follows; a kanji given-name reading (nanori) right after another kanji only when that kanji text is the contact own family name

engine.ts.memory: turns (mentions: agent listed+mentions+card, user named people + bound refs + picks), questions (open/shelved/closed, unrelated count, times asked), latest answered request, this-time-only flags, stated facts (place/time), standing requirements (kind → place/status), company → contact facts
engine.ts.parts: hint quotes when they are substrings of the message; otherwise one part unless a clause explicitly answers an open question and another carries its own request; clauses split at sentence ends, commas and also-markers; each clause is an answer (to which question), a request (kind + question / verb / time) or neutral (stays with its neighbour); two answers to different questions stay apart
engine.ts.attributeReply: explicit answer (an option's distinguishing word, ordinal, value for a value question; gone option = explicit but unclear) > response without decision (unsure words, shared surname) to an open non-shelved question within the idle limit > the question whose record kind the part names > hint (only for non-question parts with unexplained content); defer words and new requests → null; a question answered by an earlier part of the same message is not continued again; r05: an ordinal never answers a question when a list was shown after it (it counts in the newer list)
engine.ts.pickOptionFromReply: per option: words that only it has (label chunks, name forms, role synonyms, field vocabulary, unique substrings of its record), negated words subtract, weekday words canonicalised; shared words / a shared person → unclear; unsure words → unclear; gone → unclear; hint option only when the reply has unexplained content and no shared/unsure/gone evidence; r02: katakana skeleton of a Latin name / company word only this option has; concepts in another language (labels first, then the record texts); negation of Latin terms by the whole next word; more keep / delete-both field words (negated delete verbs); r04: a contact option's name counts only where person spotting finds it (name position), shared when another option's text has the same name; katakana sound skeletons of 2 consonants count only for a kana word used as a name (before さん / 社 / の方), otherwise 3+ consonants; r05: Latin / kana well-known places are rewritten in CJK before scoring options; r06: exactly one option with hit > 0 picks (two with evidence → unclear); terms counted longest first, a contained shorter term not again; negation / keep words may follow a topic particle (は / 就 / 先 …) or a Latin term; scored on the reply as written and with places rewritten (max per option, shared from either); katakana name evidence needs the same skeleton and kanaSoundsLike (vowels, diphthongs)
engine.ts.classifyFollowUp: no previous request → new (repeat allowed after anything shown); correct markers; repeat (again + show, same or no time); adjust (add / remove words, same kind); refine (only-words, sub-window or this-time); swap_period (new time, same kind, no write, follow marker / back reference / short); ask_again_about (follow marker + new person / place / record); follow_list (which-of-these, ordinal or listed item questions); hint class only when the message supports it; r02: the hint class is followed unless the message structure contradicts it (shape(): write / create, kind change, new period not inside the old one, topic turn with a full request, wh-question for refine, previous request a write, no object to swap, no contrast); own detection: contrasts (不是A是B / AじゃなくてB / not A, B / B, not A), <filter>的就行 / のだけ / ones only as refine, adjust for another category without a create, 一下 / 那个 are not follow markers, after an idle break a period swap needs a framing word, ordinal + question = follow_list before an object swap, an unknown residual word is an object for ask_again_about; r03: a contact-details word (連絡先 / phone / company) is a kind change, 谁 / の人 alone is not; repeat never with a newly named person or a kind change; add-items words read with kind words masked; follow_list never when the message names a person outside the recent mentions; ask_again_about (own or hinted) not when, besides a person, the message names content the previous request and its shown records lack (unless it says it continues: の続き / 接着); a hinted carrying class (refine / adjust / repeat / swap / ask_again) is refused on the same evidence; correction only on strong markers (contrast frame, leading no, I meant / 搞错 / 間違) — weak ones (のこと / 不是 / isn't / 应该是) only in a statement that keeps the previous kind and opens no topic; a period swap without a framing word only for a bare period (no content, no wh-question of its own)
engine.ts.resolveReference: ordinal → newest list (anchored by person / kind; mixed-kind list → ask nth of each group; out of range → none; no list → 'first' = earliest mention); pronoun → latest turn with a qualifying person (gender narrows only by the overlay, unknown never decides), content in the clause about one candidate can bind; name / content → conversation mentions linked to the person and / or matching title words (title counts double), then the account's records; bare pointer / ellipsis → latest turn with a fitting kind (sentence kind preferred, open to-dos for complete/update); after an idle break unanchored pronouns / pointers / ordinals ask with recent candidates; gone / other-account / deleted never returned; hint id promotes ask → bound only with ≥2 candidates, content support and no idle break; r02: a pointer after a name (<name>那个) makes it a record of theirs, one before it is dropped; a pointer of a kind whose modifier fits no record (a word in another language) is a pointer of that kind unless the modifier names a record this account cannot see; concepts count as content matches (title 4, text 2); "the first one" next to a list = its first item, with talk verbs = the earliest mention; pointer noun spans stop at pronouns / particles; r04: a pointer before a Latin word that belongs to a time expression (a pointer, then "next" and a week word) is no reference; r05: the ordinal itself is not a content word (so a bare ordinal after an idle break asks, R2); a plain name with several live candidates: a gendered title narrows like 他 / 她 (R17: Mr. → bind only if exactly one non-female who is known male; Ms. → drop known men, none left → none), typed tone marks keep the candidates whose tones fit (unknown tones never drop one), and a concept / distinctive Latin word of only one candidate's stored title / company / industry binds it (R1); Latin / kana place words in a reference are compared in their CJK spelling; r06: tones bind only a candidate with known fitting tones; R1 stored details only via FIELD_CONCEPTS and only when all other candidates have a title or company; among several fitting mentioned records one is kept only if it alone fits some content word / longer run / concept (score margin alone never decides); place words compared both as written and in CJK
engine.ts.carryOverSlots: own slots from the message (kind, verb, time, named people + bound person refs, place, topic patterns, status) + anaphora to facts; carried by class: swap (all but time), ask_again (all but the replaced object), refine/adjust/repeat/follow_list/correct (previous + own), new (nothing); this-time filters dropped; standing requirements re-applied per kind; r02: a contrast's positive side decides the kind; a correction naming an unknown proper noun keeps no old person; refine words that are no person / place / status become the topic; Latin city names reported in CJK; an elliptical 'anything else / that day' keeps the previous (or last mentioned) kind; status words imply to-dos; the standing kind only for messages with a person / ref / time / place / status; a question about one shown item keeps the result's this-time conditions; hint slots fill a gap only when the message shows them (time words but not an earlier window; an unknown proper noun and a person not in earlier requests; topic / place words present); r03: a contrast takes time and place from its positive side and drops the negated old value; done / open does not follow the request to another kind; a standing requirement that names no kind is about the kind being talked about (status alone → to-dos), 'all' only when said, and only a standing requirement that named its kind can supply a kind; 'this time' wins over the about-one-item rule; the kind-keeping ellipsis rules need the same people and no content of their own; hint time never a window any earlier user message or answer had; hint people never someone already mentioned; r05: place words from the gazetteer (Latin, kana via romaji, other CJK spellings) reported in their CJK spelling; a place word with an honorific / title after it is a person, not a place; r06: a kana word read as a place through its romaji needs 3+ kana
engine.ts.clarificationBudget: replyClear → go; asked ≥1 and (unrelated ≥ 2 or idle > 60) → shelve; asked ≥ askAtMost → deliver; else ask
engine.ts.next: continuing part: go if picked, else budget (deliver after one question); new part: ask if a reference is not bound or a name fits several people
engine.ts.verbs: r02: a completion word in a yes / no question without an imperative is a read (済み？ / done?); <a day>にして sets a date (update)

structure.concepts.ts: general zh / ja / en business nouns grouped into concepts (report, audit, quote, freight, research, minutes, contract …) for matching a reply / reference to an option or record written in another language; katakana and Latin consonant skeletons (a katakana rendering meets a Latin name / company word); Hepburn romaji of kana; r03: niche groups removed; r06: FIELD_CONCEPTS — the concept groups that describe a department / occupation / industry (the only ones used to separate same-name people by stored details)
structure.pinyin.ts: toneless pinyin of ~880 common characters grouped by syllable (general frequency list for names and company words, name readings for polyphones) plus compound surnames; a name or company core is romanised only when every character is known; r05: TONES (tone digits aligned with BY_SYLLABLE, a row that does not line up gives no tones) and SUPPLEMENT (≈200 more given-name / surname characters with pinyin and tone); tonesOfChars
structure.names.ts: r05: soundKey (consonant classes, vowel onset, first two vowels) for Latin spellings, Hepburn romaji and pinyin; kanaSoundsLike (honorific after: key match; otherwise same spelling once the kana's added final vowel is dropped — loanwords never match by key alone); TRANSLIT (standard Chinese phonetic transliteration characters) and translitSoundsLike (consonant key, w as v or silent); tonesOf (tone marks of a typed romanisation); NANORI (readings of kanji common in Japanese given names) and kanjiReadsAs; r06: kanaSoundsLike rejects a kana diphthong (ai / ei) for a Latin spelling without one; translitSoundsLike checks the pinyin first vowel against the Latin first vowel (NUCLEUS_FOR)
structure.engine.ts#tasks: r07: Engine.tasks: each change the user asked for (slots, card, target, status open/done/cancelled, last-touched order). Added by a write request, a write question (q.for), or a card; done by a matching done write. TurnCtx.changeOf(): cancel (CANCEL_MARKERS on a waiting change) → nothing written, no request; resume (names the person of an interrupted open change, or RESUME_MARKERS) → that change's slots; copy (COPY / OTHER markers + another person or record) → kind and verb of the last change, own people / topic, time only with SAME_DAY words; amend (AMEND / correction markers on the waiting change, no other record) → the change with only the said slots replaced; a correction marker makes followUp correct.
structure.engine.ts#facts: r07: statement facts split per subject (me / one contact) when a sentence states several; <person>がいる方 / my side → that subject's place; the day of <person> → that person's fact day; 那附近 / その辺 → latest fact place; userAlias (我说X就是Y / Xって言ったら / when I say X I mean) binds X to the one contact Y describes; companyContact keyed by stored company.
structure.engine.ts#refs: r07: the other one (另一个 / もう一つ / the other one) = the last list minus what was acted on or named since (bind only if exactly one is left and something was acted on); <company>の方 / 的窗口 → that company's people (company fact first, bind only if the company has one contact); <field>的那位 → among the latest turn's people the one whose stored details have that field; a person named earlier in the same sentence is the latest mention for a pronoun after it; overlapping reference spans merge; time-anchored pointers (今夜の… / tonight's …).
structure.engine.ts#picks: r07: a plain yes answers a one-option confirmation; the part of the day (morning / afternoon / evening) picks the one option whose label time is in it; a responsive answer goes to the question whose options share the name it says.
structure.world.ts#r07: r07: kana place words only as whole kana words; placeDisplay keeps the stored spelling; umlaut ue/oe/ae forms; a kanji surname learned from readings also names Latin-named contacts with that family name; kanji spellings of kana given names also before a person pointer; name groups do not merge across a clause break / contrast when the later side names its own person.
structure.parts: undefined; r08: hint parts that are bare (a greeting / acknowledgement ≤ bareHintPartMaxChars with no refs, slots, kind, verb, question, person) join their neighbour; with no question open, a hint part with nothing of a request of its own (no kind word, verb, question) joins the neighbouring request, its refs kept
structure.resolveReference: undefined; r08 (real-model hints): hint saids are reconciled with the message's own spans — a said that is a strict part of an own span is widened to it (a person said only over a record-pointer tail, or when the wider words bind one record), split pointer halves overlapping a widened said are dropped, a lone 那/这 is no reference, a list position the hint left out replaces a possessive owner said, own record pointers with a kind word the hint missed are added; <person>の<title words>(の)メモ/タスク/件 spans (Latin / hiragana words allowed, no particles); a span cut inside 纪要-type words is completed; person + concepts in another language pick the record with most concepts; a kind-less pointer (the X one / Xの方) in a what-about follow-up takes the previous request's kind, in a copy the latest change's kind; bare もう一つ (no create verb) = the other one, with concept fit on titles; r09: every reference span (own or reconciled, not the caller keepSaid) is trimmed of function words on both ends (trimRefSpan): zh 把/将 with request words before, framing …的是, a preposition (跟/给/和…) only before a bare person + pointer (kept before a description or 的); ja leading conjunction / case particle, trailing particle; en leading discourse words / articles / verbs, a preposition before a pointer or person, a trailing preposition; never cuts the start of a person name
structure.carryOverSlots: ; r08: in a contrast (不是A，是B) a person only the negated side names (via a model reference) is dropped
structure.confirm.ts: r10: R34 duplicatesOf (content units: CJK bigrams, Latin words, concepts, action groups a*, object groups o*; action bigrams are no object; to-do: same person + one object unit (or an action-only title), no person: one object + dupMinShared units and half the title units capped at dupTitleUnitsCap; done to-do only when its planned / due / notes day is the request day; memo: same quoted title or same person + 2 object units; schedule: same day, same clock, same person or one object unit); R35 linksOf (contact: account records with its id; event: attendance, to-dos / memos with its event id); R37 isRecurring / occurrencesIn (regular days by the rule, moved by exceptions, cancelled flagged); anotherOnPurpose (再建一条同样的 / 同じ…もう一つ / another one)
structure.engine.ts#next: r10: decideNext(new part): confirmReason → ask (not-a-request: greeting / filler only or an undecided word that answers nothing (R38, R41); plural pronoun count disagrees (R44); create: no kind + a named person + reported speech (R39), schedule without a day (R40), duplicate of an account record or of a write done in this conversation unless one more on purpose (R34); update: a vague shift with no value (R40); update / delete: target (bound refs, contact person, or the one record whose title the words cover) still linked (R35, delete) or recurring without exactly one live occurrence in the time words before the change verb, unless all occurrences are meant (R37)); else hint clarity missing_one / none → ask; clarity clear / statement lifts an ask from own references; amend / resume / cancel of a waiting change never confirm. narrowSeries: several recurring series of one title keep the one with an occurrence in the target window.
structure.engine.ts#r10-refs: r10: ellipsis reference (R32) for a change with no object (the predicate from the verb on), only with no person, no content, no waiting change; もう1つ in a create is no reference; ordinals of the talk (最后一个<问题> / the first thing I should / 第一件该<做>) and edition numbers (第<n>届 / 第3回) are no list positions (also for follow_list); この先 / 这个月 are no pointers; <person>の<time>の予定 in a question is a set; <content>的待办 for a change; R43 lookups: 上次去的 / 前回行った <event> = the latest attended event (attendance went) of that event noun before now; a title covered by the words (titleCoverMinUnits / titleCoverShare) binds, also across the counter's kind (<event title>那条); a pointer with content words in a change (<word>那条改到…) asks among the titles that have every content word (one binds when a word has looseBindMinChars+); follow_list never when the message names an unlisted record by its title; 这人 / 那人 are person pointers; 他们 / 她们 are not 他 / 她
structure.engine.ts#r10-requests: r10: plural pronouns (他们俩 / 彼ら二人 / the two of them) = every person of the latest turn naming people (R44); a person added to the waiting change (也加上 / も追加 / add … as well) amends it with the union of people; 有空 / 空いてる / am I free → schedule; one more (再加一条 / もう1件 / another) → the latest change's kind; 加进日程 / 放进 calendar / add to my calendar → create; 新規作成 / 记一篇 / 加一条 → create; 推一推 / 往后推 → update; <verb>済みの (<verb>済みの) and 已完成的 are states, not verbs; <kind>を追加して：… is a new record (not adjust); 出发前一天 / 出発の前日 / the day before I fly → the day before the stated trip day; the Monday after next (time.ts); an intent question without options answered by a kind word (<kind>吧 / <kind>のほうで) continues it with the kind (R45); an also-clause asking something done (还有…帮我弄一下 / それと…やっといて) is its own part, neutral pieces after a sentence end join what follows
